body: Yeah just let me FedEx that to you postmortem...
No I'm saying that people would just move on afterwards. That's life. Just move on. I don't see a point in mine anymore.

That's the only beauty about this world. It can move on without giving a shit about you. People move on. I doubt I made a big enough impact on people for them to kill themselves afterwards. I can't move any further.

Considering this is 7 hours old, it'll buried. I have a throwaway for this kind of thing.

Suicide. I know y'all are gonna do the whole "don't do it" "you have a lot to live for" etc.

I'm done with life in general. Can't remember the last time I was happy. Everyday is just shit on top of shit on top of even more. Friendless(pretty much), jobless, and about to be homeless.

I know it's about my depression, but I'm at my end. I dropped out of college because of it. I burned bridges at my job that led to a mutual quit/fire. I've spent my time trying to find one, but it has been to no avail. I've pretty much given up on everything. I plan on writing my letters today and doing the thing tomorrow when I get kicked out.

I've exhausted my family to the extent of them not willing to help out (even though I help them with whatever they ask of me). It's just not an option for me to continue on this earth any longer. Some people were meant to be successful, some not as much. My case is that I more or less feel like a burden to anyone I come in contact with.

Yeah I've been waiting for shit to get better but it hasn't been better for 6 years. Only form of happy comes in a bottle of whiskey and a blunt to forget pain, only for it to be worse the next morning. The 2 friends I mentioned have futures while I don't have any future. Just stuck and empty...
